t:
Reference of all ⟦0⟧ functional cluster APIs, automatically
extracted from the official R25-11 specification PDFs (Chapter 8 “API specification” or
Chapter 9 “Service Interfaces”). Each entry states the AUTOSAR requirement ID
([SWS_…], linked to the respective specification PDF) as well as the upstream requirements
(RS_…). Identity and Access Management (IAM) does not have its own up to and including R25-11
C++ API and is therefore not included.
